candidates: When adding links to GitHub Issues in project documentation, consolidate open and closed issue searches into a single link using the `?q=is%3Aissue` query parameter (e.g., `https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/issues?q=is%3Aissue`) and label it to indicate it covers both states (e.g., 'Search in Issues (Open & Closed)'), rather than providing separate links for open and closed issues.
